Who scores first in the WNBA? This page counts the first field goal of every WNBA game in 2026 (330 regular season, 16 playoffs, 1 play-in) from the play-by-play, then breaks it down by player, team and scoring method. These are the same labels our [first basket models](../wnba/first-basket-picks.qmd) learn from; the models add tonight's lineups, the opponent and the price at every sportsbook.

## How first baskets are scored

| Method | First baskets | Share |
|---|---:|---:|
| Layup | 158 | 46% |
| 3-pointer | 101 | 29% |
| Other 2-pointer (jumper, hook, tip) | 88 | 25% |

In 18 of 347 games (5%) the game's first points came from a different player than its first field goal, usually a free throw. That is the difference between a *first points* market and a *first field goal* market; our [first basket guide](../guides/what-is-a-first-basket-bet.qmd) explains which books use which.

::: {.faq-item}
### Who scored the most first baskets in the WNBA in 2026?

Shakira Austin, with 11 first baskets of the game in 45 starts (24%). Paige Bueckers was second with 9.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### How often does the home team score first in the WNBA?

In 2026, the home team made the first field goal in 50% of games.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### How often does the team that wins the tipoff score first?

In 220 of 347 games with a recorded opening tip (63%), the team that won it also made the first field goal. Winning the ball helps, but a missed first shot hands the chance to the other side.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Are these the picks?

No. This page is history. The picks come from our models, which combine this history with tonight's starting lineup, the opponent, pace and the price at each book, and post to Discord when a price is better than the projection. See [WNBA first basket picks](../wnba/first-basket-picks.qmd).
:::
